editorial:
Imagine winning a free trip to a tropical island where your wildest dreams come true. That is the promise of Fantasy Island, where a group of lucky contest winners arrive at a fancy hotel run by a mysterious host. Each guest gets to live out their deepest fantasy, whether it is revenge, romance, or a second chance at life. At first, everything feels like a dream vacation. But soon, the fantasies twist into dark nightmares, and the guests realize they are trapped. The island has a mind of its own, and leaving is not as easy as it sounds.

The movie mixes adventure, fantasy, horror, and mystery into one wild ride. The acting is solid, and the tropical setting looks great on screen. The pacing keeps you guessing, though some twists feel a bit messy. It is fun if you enjoy spooky thrills without too much gore. Fans of creepy island stories will have a good time.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you learn the island is powered by a magical stone that makes fantasies real. The host, Mr. Roarke, is bound to the island and cannot leave. The guests discover that their fantasies are connected and that one of them caused the chaos. The twist reveals that the island feeds on their desires and fears. In the end, the survivors escape by destroying the stone's power, but Mr. Roarke stays behind, forever trapped. The final shot hints the island will welcome new guests soon.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves spooky island adventures with a mix of fantasy and mystery.
